description: Sync step 2. Render-ready PUBLISHED blog article: HTML body with absolute image/link URLs, schemaGraph (JSON-LD), siteMetadata, canonical, author, breadcrumb, related posts, plus meta (contentHash, updatedAt, publishedAt, path). Full payload, never truncated. Identify by id or slug (add publicationId if the slug exists in several publications).

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

ifContentHash.description: meta.contentHash from your last export of this item; if unchanged you get { unchanged: true } instead of the body.

version.description: "published" (default) = what is live. "draft" = the editor's current version, for previews only.

name: export_blog_article
